# Hesper Kettle

## Description
A dwarf of sixty with forearms like anchor chain, a leather apron scorched to lace,
and a pencil of soft iron behind one ear for marking blades. Says prices once. Does
not say them again. Has a sign over the forge door that reads "NO CREDIT, NO HAGGLING,
NO GEESE".

## Personality & motivation
Blunt, fair, incurious about anything that is not metal. Midwinter is her best week of
the year: everyone wants crampons, skates and a knife for the goose. She would never
sell a bad blade. She will not lower a price for a sad story, a royal name or the
end of the world, and she has heard all three this morning.

## Knowledge & secrets
- Freely shares: prices; that the skates on the lake's south shore are hers ("sold three pairs to a fisherman, he never came back for the fourth"); that the Keep's parade armour "is mine, hollow, and should stay hollow"
- Needs persuasion (DC 12): the Goose-Cleaver was made for Bergmann, who refused it on principle; it has sat in the window since "this morning, or so"
- Never: she notices nothing wrong with the day and will not be told
